name: League Broadcast Windfall
description: A new national TV deal is signed mid-season. All teams receive an equal revenue bonus for the next four weeks.

name: All-Star Voting Surge
description: Fan voting opens for the All-Star Game. Attendance climbs 10% league-wide for two weeks as fans engage.

name: Commissioner's Bonus Pool
description: The commissioner distributes a league performance fund. All teams receive minor salary cap relief this week.

name: Sports Medicine Summit
description: A league-wide sports medicine conference shares new recovery protocols. All teams see a 15% reduction in injury recovery time for three weeks.

name: Equipment Upgrade Initiative
description: New league-issued performance gear is distributed. All players receive a minor stat boost for two weeks.

name: Referee Training Week
description: Officiating staff undergo advanced training. Foul accuracy improves and controversial calls drop for the next two weeks.

name: International Talent Fair
description: An overseas scouting event opens the global player pool. Each team can sign one free international prospect this week.

name: Hall of Fame Legacy Tour
description: Legends from the Hall of Fame tour all stadiums. Veterans receive a morale and stat boost from the inspiration.

name: Referee Strike Threat
description: Officials threaten a walkout over pay disputes. Game quality drops and controversial calls increase for two weeks.

name: Flu Epidemic
description: A virulent flu strain sweeps through locker rooms league-wide. Every team loses one random player to illness for one week.

name: Salary Cap Audit
description: The league audits all team payrolls. One team chosen at random faces a cap penalty and must shed a contract this week.

name: Trade Deadline Panic
description: Mass trades trigger a wave of roster uncertainty league-wide. All teams experience temporary chemistry disruption as rosters shuffle.

name: Major Storm Rescheduling
description: Severe storms force postponements across several cities. All teams must play additional back-to-back games to make up the schedule.

name: Performance Enhancing Scandal
description: An unnamed player tests positive for a banned substance. League-wide scrutiny intensifies and player morale dips from the cloud of suspicion.

name: TV Rights Blackout Dispute
description: A broadcast rights dispute blacks out games in major markets. Attendance and media revenue drop for all teams for two weeks.

name: Commissioner Controversy
description: The commissioner issues an unpopular ruling on a disciplinary matter. Player frustration rises and morale drops league-wide.

name: Emergency Cap Reduction
description: The league reduces salary caps mid-season due to financial shortfalls. All teams are forced to adjust payroll, creating morale strain.

name: Hometown Hero Breakout
description: A local player has a surprise standout week. Team morale spikes and home attendance rises as the city rallies behind the story.

name: Win Streak Bonus
description: The team's current winning run earns a locker room financial bonus. Morale climbs and the next two games see improved cohesion.

name: Local Sponsorship Signing
description: A regional business signs a major sponsorship deal. The team receives a revenue bonus that can be reinvested into the roster or facilities.

name: Rookie Breakout Performance
description: Your rookie surprises everyone with a standout performance. Their rating increases permanently and the locker room's faith in them grows.

name: Captain's Speech
description: The team captain delivers an emotional motivational address. The entire squad receives a morale boost that lasts two weeks.

name: Early Injury Return
description: An injured player recovers ahead of schedule. They return to the roster at full strength sooner than expected, improving your depth.

name: Home Field Improvement
description: Local upgrades are made to your stadium's playing surface and atmosphere. Home win probability increases for the next four home games.

name: Star Player Endorsement
description: Your best player lands a major national endorsement deal. Team profile and morale both rise as the spotlight shines on the squad.

name: Cap Space Opens Unexpectedly
description: An accounting adjustment reveals available salary cap space. You can sign one free agent at a discounted rate this week.

name: Locker Room Argument
description: Two players clash publicly after a difficult loss. Team chemistry drops for two weeks and both players see performance dips.

name: Star Player Ankle Injury
description: Your best player rolls an ankle in practice. They are sidelined for one to three weeks, weakening your starting lineup significantly.

name: Coaching Staff Power Struggle
description: An assistant coach publicly demands a bigger role. The distraction undermines staff cohesion and team morale drops for two weeks.

name: Key Player Suspension
description: A player receives an unexpected ban following a disciplinary review. Your lineup is weakened for the next one to two games.

name: Sponsorship Withdrawal
description: Your main sponsor pulls out of the deal following a controversy. The team loses a significant revenue stream for the rest of the month.

name: Transfer Demand
description: An unhappy player formally requests to leave. Roster focus is disrupted as management handles negotiations publicly.

name: Harsh Media Criticism
description: A prominent journalist publishes a critical exposé targeting your team's culture. Fan confidence and recruitment appeal both decline.

name: Home Crowd Turns
description: Frustration with recent results boils over and home fans boo the squad. Your home win advantage is temporarily neutralized.

name: Captain Injury
description: Your team captain is injured in a game. Beyond the roster gap, the leadership vacuum causes a morale drop across the squad.

name: Star Player Illness
description: Your top performer comes down with an illness at the worst time. They miss one to two games and return at reduced capacity.

name: Team Chemistry Fracture
description: Factional cliques form in the locker room over playing time. Team-wide cohesion and performance drop for three weeks.

name: League Photo Day
description: All teams gather for official league photos. No gameplay effects — just good team headshots for the record books.

name: Jersey Number Debate
description: Two players informally discuss swapping jersey numbers. It goes no further, nothing changes on the pitch.

name: Mascot Costume Malfunction
description: Your team mascot's costume fails spectacularly on camera. It becomes a brief viral moment. Zero on-field consequences.

name: Staff Birthday Party
description: A surprise party is organized for the equipment manager. Players are in good spirits for an afternoon, but nothing carries over to game day.
